Author: Asunnya (fork of Anomek's AnoMech)
Name: AsuMech
Punchline: Another FFXIV mechanics simulator: a fork of AnoMech with Savage, more Ultimates and a Learn mode.
Description: Asunnya's fork of AnoMech: spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Everything from AnoMech, plus Savage (M9S to M11S), DSR, UCOB and UWU, and a Learn mode that guides you through each strat.
Changelog: 0.6.0.1: a recording you sent is removed from your disk (Settings can keep a copy), and Settings can delete every saved recording. 0.6: AnoMech is now AsuMech. Uninstall AnoMech: AsuMech imports its settings (relay, streaks, recent fights) the first time it starts. New: a Learn mode that guides you through each strat step by step, with the strat's toolbox picture and a thumbs up/down on every step; Report a problem from inside a run (a solo run pauses while you write, and the run's details are sent with it); scenario and strat requests no longer need a GitHub account; your best streak shows beside your streak. Multiplayer now uses the AsuMech server by default.
